description: Minimal single-table validation of branch token attribution. Resource is hardcoded so no template variables can interfere.

panels.description: Raw join: hook mapping events -> copilot-chat token spans, grouped by repo + branch.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let branchMap = traces
| where tostring(customDimensions["event"]) == "branch.session.start"
| extend session_key = tostring(customDimensions["session.id"]), branch = tostring(customDimensions["branch.id"]), repo = tostring(customDimensions["repo.name"])
| where isnotempty(branch)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, branch, repo) by session_key;
dependencies
| where tostring(customDimensions["service.name"]) == "copilot-chat"
| extend session_key = tostring(customDimensions["copilot_chat.chat_session_id"]), input_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"]), output_tokens = toint(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"]), model = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.response.model"])
| where isnotempty(session_key) and isnotempty(model)
| join kind=inner branchMap on session_key
| summarize Tokens = sum(input_tokens) + sum(output_tokens), Input = sum(input_tokens), Output = sum(output_tokens), Sessions = dcount(session_key) by repo, branch
| order by Tokens desc
